inj.note: With Kirk Cousins helping orchestrate a second-half comeback, Mendoza stayed glued to the sideline for the third straight contest after playing 10 offensive snaps in Week 5 against New England. The Raiders are 4-4 with Cousins playing reasonably well to keep the team in the postseason mix. Mendoza figures to get his shot if/when the Raiders are eliminated from postseason contention.

news.h: Raiders' Kubiak on switching to QB Mendoza: 'We're thinking about everything'
news.d: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said the team is thinking about everything, including turning to QB Fernando Mendoza, amid a four-game losing streak.
